name: training-lock-motion-feedback
description: Verify continuous Power training, movement lock, visible exit state, impact sound/VFX, dummy shake, and movement restoration.

args.code:
do
 local function verifyEphemeralSeed(player, world, storage)
  assert(world and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceMode')=='EphemeralStudio','fixture requires an ephemeral Studio world')
  assert(world:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioDefaultEphemeral')==true and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioLiveDataOptIn')==false,'world allows live profile access')
  assert(storage:GetAttribute('PunchWallAllowLiveDataStoreAccess')~=true,'ServerStorage opts into live data')
  assert(player and player:GetAttribute('ProfileReady')==true and player:GetAttribute('ProfilePersistenceState')=='EphemeralStudio' and player:GetAttribute('ProfileWritable')==false,'fixture requires a ready nonwritable ephemeral player')
  return true
 end
 assert(game:GetService('RunService'):IsStudio(),'combat QA is Studio-only')
 local players=game:GetService('Players'):GetPlayers() assert(#players==1,'combat QA requires exactly one isolated player')
 verifyEphemeralSeed(players[1],workspace:FindFirstChild('PunchWallRPG'),game:GetService('ServerStorage'))
end
local function verifyTrainingPayout(before, immediate, after, rate, tickSeconds)
 assert(immediate.Power==before.Power and immediate.payoutSerial==before.payoutSerial and immediate.sessionTickCount==0,'training paid before a scheduled tick')
 assert(immediate.sessionGeneration==before.sessionGeneration+1 and immediate.active and immediate.movementLocked,'training did not start one locked session')
 local ticks=after.sessionTickCount local delta=after.Power-before.Power
 assert(ticks>=1 and ticks<=2 and ticks==math.floor(ticks),'missing or excessive first scheduled tick batch')
 assert(after.payoutSerial==immediate.payoutSerial+1 and after.lastTickBatch==ticks,'duplicate or unaccounted payout batch')
 assert(delta==rate*ticks and after.lastGrant==delta and after.gainPerSecond==rate,'training rate differs from the server station configuration')
 assert(math.abs(after.tickAnchor-immediate.tickAnchor-ticks*tickSeconds)<1e-5,'payout did not consume exactly its scheduled intervals')
 assert(after.active and after.movementLocked,'training unlocked before its payout was observed')
 return true
end

immediate=a:Invoke('TrainingSnapshot') assert(result.gain==0,'unexpected instant training payout') local after=immediate local deadline=os.clock()+2.6 repeat task.wait(.04) after=a:Invoke('TrainingSnapshot') until after.payoutSerial>immediate.payoutSerial or os.clock()>=deadline local exactPayout=verifyTrainingPayout(beforeSnapshot,immediate,after,G.TrainingStation('rookie_bag').gain,G.Training.TickSeconds) local h=p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid') local root=workspace.PunchWallRPG local station=root.Interactables:FindFirstChild('Power Bag') local impact=station and station:FindFirstChild('Training Impact') local bag=root:FindFirstChild('Creator Store Hero Power Bag',true) local shake=0 for _,d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do shake=math.max(shake,tonumber(d:GetAttribute('TrainingShakeToken')) or 0) end local bagAsset=bag and bag:GetAttribute('AssetId') local minV=Vector3.new(math.huge,math.huge,math.huge) local maxV=Vector3.new(-math.huge,-math.huge,-math.huge) if bag then for _,d in ipairs(bag:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('BasePart') then for xs=-1,1,2 do for ys=-1,1,2 do for zs=-1,1,2 do local v=d.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(d.Size.X*xs*.5,d.Size.Y*ys*.5,d.Size.Z*zs*.5)) minV=Vector3.new(math.min(minV.X,v.X),math.min(minV.Y,v.Y),math.min(minV.Z,v.Z)) maxV=Vector3.new(math.max(maxV.X,v.X),math.max(maxV.Y,v.Y),math.max(maxV.Z,v.Z)) end end end end end end local bagSize=maxV-minV return H:JSONEncode({ok=result.ok==true and p.RPGStats.TrainingActive.Value==1 and p.leaderstats.Power.Value>before and h and h.WalkSpeed==0 and h.JumpPower==0 and h.JumpHeight==0 bagSize.Y>bagSize.X and bagSize.Y>bagSize.Z and math.abs(minV.Y-.35)<.05,exactPayout=exactPayout,powerBefore=before,powerAfter=p.leaderstats.Power.Value,walk=h and h.WalkSpeed or args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local hud=g.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD local overlay=hud:FindFirstChild('TrainingStateHUD') local exit=overlay and overlay:FindFirstChild('ExitTraining') return H:JSONEncode({ok=overlay~=nil and overlay.Visible and exit~=nil and exit.Active and g:GetAttribute('TrainingExitButtonReady')==true and g:GetAttribute('ContinuousTrainingAnimation')==true,visible=overlay and overlay.Visible or false,exit=exit~=nil,continuous=g:GetAttribute('ContinuousTrainingAnimation')})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1]
local r=c:Invoke('StopTraining') local before=c:Invoke('TrainingSnapshot') task.wait(1.2) local after=c:Invoke('TrainingSnapshot')
local h=p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
local noLeak=after.Power==before.Power and after.payoutSerial==before.payoutSerial and after.tickAnchor==nil
local ok=r.ok==true and not after.active and not after.movementLocked and h and h.WalkSpeed>0 and h.JumpPower>0 and h.JumpHeight>0 and h.AutoRotate==true and noLeak
assert(ok,'stop failed to restore movement or leaked a training payout')
return H:JSONEncode({ok=ok,noLeak=noLeak,walk=h.WalkSpeed,jump=h.JumpPower})
